candidate: same-slot all unordered pairs of predetermined RNG outputs, bbox-only perceptual distances
preferred_family: ROI-only masked spatial LPIPS; NOT full-image LPIPS subsequently masked while claiming strict isolation

primary_source.checked_code: LPIPS.forward: spatial maps are upsampled from network features; ordinary mode averages spatially. Spatial=True does not itself accept or enforce a defect mask.

reproducibility_requirements: pin LPIPS repository revision, trained weight SHA, backbone/version, eval mode and preprocessing before any image measurement
crop exact same recorded raster B from each G; no normal/reference defect substitution
keep original coordinate/support record, RGB scaling and aspect ratio; any padding/upsampling is fixed identically across all pairs
prove the fixed backbone accepts every frozen ROI shape using architecture-only constraints before runtime; do not silently exclude small boxes
all pair distances and per-slot aggregate reported; do not choose maximum/diverse/top-ranked pair
freeze implementation and aggregation independent of seen A/B/C utility; k*(k-1)/2 correlated pairs are not independent replicates

small_roi_evidence.consequence: No guarantee that native tiny ROIs are legal for all LPIPS backbones. Native resolution vs deterministic padding/upsampling still unresolved; no arbitrary resize-to-256 declared valid.

mask_and_context_limits: B is weak bbox: residual normal texture inside it participates; masked LPIPS cannot isolate a true defect silhouette
masking an output feature map after feeding a full patch leaks outside-bbox context through receptive fields
cropping both inputs to B prevents real outside-bbox pixels entering, but introduces fixed crop padding/boundary effects; do not claim per-pixel independence
input masking can itself create edges; spatial-map masking is not equivalent to exact ROI-only feature extraction
interpretation: appearance variation only. Large distance may be artifact/class drift; near-zero distance may be collapse. Neither establishes defect validity.
